BizYour by DILIGENCE
For Cosmetics & Footwear Shops

Billing and stock for cosmetics & footwear shops — in one app.

Cosmetics and footwear counters share the same daily reality: many brands, many shades and sizes, quick trials, quick returns, and regulars who expect the shop to remember them. BizYour keeps billing, stock, returns and customer udhaar in one app, so the counter stays fast and the records stay true.

What your shop gets

  • Fast, clean billing — bills in seconds, shared on WhatsApp as a PDF with your shop's name — no printer needed.
  • Stock across brands and ranges — every product in one stock list with low-stock alerts, so a bestseller shade or size is reordered in time.
  • Returns without friction — returned items re-enter stock against their bill; exchanges stay recorded, not remembered.
  • Customer udhaar — regular customers' credit and payments in a clear ledger, with a hisab link they can open themselves.
  • Purchases in the same place — distributor purchases update the same stock automatically — one record from shelf to bill.
  • GST reports ready — GST bills, reports and a GSTR-1 file for your CA from the same data; GST can be switched off if you are not registered.

Buy from distributors inside the same app

Business Mart is BizYour's built-in B2B bazaar, and it is free. Ask distributors for quotes on your brand list, order from the best quote, and when the stock arrives it records itself as a purchase and updates your shelf count.

Common questions

My customers return or exchange often. Does stock stay right?

Yes. Sale returns are built in: the item goes back into stock against its original bill, and the exchange is recorded in the same flow.

Can my staff bill without seeing my profits?

Yes. Staff get their own logins with role limits — billing and stock only. Profit and reports stay with the owner.

Do I need a printer or a computer?

No. Bills are shared with the customer on WhatsApp as a PDF, and BizYour runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

What does it cost?

Business Mart is free forever. The Workspace is free for the first 30 days — no card, no automatic charge. After the trial you choose a monthly or yearly plan inside the app; if you wait, your data stays visible in read-only form and nothing is deleted.
